name: Close Interaction
description: A tight crop combining part of a face with the product genuinely in use against it — a serum near a cheek, a fragrance near a collarbone, headphones over an ear — closer and more intimate than a standard headshot portrait.
lighting: Soft close beauty light, true skin luminosity
subject: person
prompt: an extreme close crop combining part of a face — cheek, jaw, collarbone, or ear depending on how the product is actually used — with the product held or worn genuinely against the skin in natural real-world use, soft close beauty-style lighting giving true luminous skin rendering with a real soft catchlight, shallow depth of field with the point of contact between skin and product tack-sharp while the rest of the face and background dissolve into soft blur, natural unposed micro-expression rather than a full smiling portrait, no full face visible, no other people, intimate high-end beauty-campaign register with genuine skin texture, never waxy or over-retouched
